parent_lockpick_interface.interpretation: The broad interface is too coarse to attack directly; exact OR3 coverage is already available locally, while the unresolved work is global coherence of sheet choices without SAT-equivalent explicit selectors.

next_exact_gate.objective: Construct an exact deterministic polynomial interface that absorbs per-constraint three-sheet choice into a globally coherent tractable representation without an explicit SAT-like selector, exponential branching, hidden semantic oracle, or superpolynomial state.

open_literature_audit.source: Cohen, Jeavons, Jonsson, Koubarakis, Building tractable disjunctive constraints, JACM 47(5), 2000, DOI 10.1145/355483.355485
open_literature_audit.relevance: General disjunctive tractability is obtained under independence-style conditions plus tractability of restricted mixed instances.
open_literature_audit.janus_binding: The frozen direct three-sheet split fails the required 1-independence route; repeating direct refinement/independence search on the same representation is an anti-loop.

open_literature_audit.source: CSPs with Few Alien Constraints, CP 2024, LIPIcs.CP.2024.15
open_literature_audit.relevance: When alien relations are finite unions of pp-definable tractable relations, CSP with at most k alien constraints is FPT parameterized by k.
open_literature_audit.janus_binding: Our three-sheet disjunction occurs per original clause, so k is unbounded in general. The theorem validates bounded-alien branching as a parameterized positive region, not a universal polynomial compiler.

open_literature_audit.source: Gaspers, Misra, Ordyniak, Szeider, Zivny, Backdoors into Heterogeneous Classes of SAT and CSP, arXiv:1509.05725
open_literature_audit.relevance: Heterogeneous backdoors can route different assignments into different tractable base classes.
open_literature_audit.janus_binding: This is parameterized by backdoor structure/size; no source theorem supplies a universal polynomial bound for arbitrary signed 3CNF.

open_literature_audit.source: Dreier, Ordyniak, Szeider, CSP Beyond Tractable Constraint Languages, CP 2022
open_literature_audit.relevance: Backdoor depth yields FPT algorithms for fixed tractable semi-conservative languages.
open_literature_audit.janus_binding: Again parameterized; it does not remove the need for a universally bounded global coherence certificate.

open_literature_audit.source: Bhangale, Harsha, Varma, A Characterization of hard-to-cover CSPs, arXiv:1411.7747
open_literature_audit.relevance: Covering CSP studies multiple assignments whose union covers constraints.
open_literature_audit.janus_binding: Different objective: our target is one satisfying assignment with globally coherent sheet choices, so covering-CSP results are not a direct solver donor.
